text:
Ashley: Heads up — product asked for a plan to gracefully handle v1 clients once v2 becomes default. We need routing, quota, and console UX. Thoughts?
Vikram: +1. We shouldn't silently drop them. Options: route by header `X-Redwood-API-Version: 1`, implicit fallback for unknown clients, or return 426 Upgrade Required with migration hints.
Marta: Telemetry note — we need a reliable signal to measure v1 traffic. User-Agent is messy. Can we add a `client_version` tag in the proxy and emit a sampled metric?
Jules: Console UX: show a per-customer banner and a migration insights view listing top routes and request counts still hitting v1. Also add a timeline estimate for migration impact.
Sean: Quotas: legacy clients may have different patterns. If we keep them on v1 route, we should map them to a "legacy" quota bucket so they don't consume modern optimized pools unexpectedly.
Ashley: Example routing rule I'm thinking:
```
if header('X-Redwood-API-Version') == '1' then route -> v1-cluster
else route -> v2-cluster
```
Plus a fallback: unknown -> trial run on v2 but fall back to v1 on mismatch.
Vikram: For rollout, propose phased policy: 1) soft-fallback (no user-visible error) for 7 days with telemetry, 2) after 7 days send Deprecation header + console banner, 3) after 30 days start returning 426 for failing clients. Need exact windows in RFC.
Marta: Also add alerts: spike in 426s or spike in v1->v2 fallbacks should trigger pager. And create a dashboard: v1 request count, v2 migration success rate, fallback rate, 426 rate.
Jules: We'll need copy for the banner and support templates. Keep the banner actionable: "Upgrade to v2 — one-line migration guide + links to SDKs". :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy/prod: routing-proxy v2-rollout queued (build 8842) — ETA 12m.
Sean: One quirk: metrics & billing. If v1 tokens cost more, migrating customers might see cost changes. We should add a migration-preview cost estimator in Console.
Ashley: Agreed. Action items: Vikram — routing PR + canary plan; Marta — telemetry tags + dashboard widgets; Jules — banner copy & migration insights mock; Sean — quota mapping & billing estimator spec. I'll open an RFC doc with timeline and attach these items. Anyone object?
Vikram: No objections. I'll start the PR and link it to the RFC.
Marta: I'll add the metrics and a sample query for ops.
Jules: I'll draft the console copy + help center article.
Sean: I'll sketch quota mapping and send a note to finance about the estimator.
Ashley: Great. Thanks all. We'll revisit after the canary. :eyes:
